- Esperienza con conti giornalieri, gestione del contante e controllo delle operazioni in front office

- Flessibilità e buona conoscenza dei processi di lavoro nell'area della sede centrale.

- Buone abilità informatiche dei programmi di MS Office.

- Maniere impeccabili e aspetto ben tenuto.

What you can do with us

As a Night Auditor, you are an important contact person for our international guests during the night and ensure that the front office processes and high service and quality standards are run smoothly.

They complement our Front Office Team and are responsible for the following • tasks:

- You receive our international guests professionally and warmly, perform check-in and check-outs and take care of your requests and wishes individually.

- They guarantee a first-class guest service during the night according to the high standards of an international 5-star luxury hotel.

- You will take over the tasks at the front office, the cash register and the back office and will be responsible for the completion of the day's accounts as well as the control of the relevant bookings, transactions and cash registers.

- You will work closely with the office, Housekeeping, Security and other operational departments and support the Front Office, Guest Relations and Guest Experience Team if necessary.

• Your profile

For this very varied position, you ideally bring the following:

- Completed training in the hotel industry or completion of a hotel school.

- At least 2-3 years of professional experience at the front office, ideally as a night auditor or in a comparable position in the 5-star luxury hotel industry.

- Very good knowledge of operational and administrative front office procedures.

- Experience with day-to-day accounts, cash management and control of front office transactions

- Flexibility and good knowledge of the working processes in the front office area.

- Very good knowledge of German and English, Italian or Russian.

- Good computer skills of MS Office programs.

- Impeccable manners and well-kept appearance.

- High level of commitment, flexibility and joy in working at night.

- A strong team orientation and at the same time the ability to make decisions independently.

Our offer

- Temporary season position from the end of November 2026 until the end of March 2027.

- 5-day week on average at 43.5 hours.

- 5 weeks of holidays and 6 holidays per year.

- 13. Pay from entrance (per rate of temporis).

- On request at the beginning accommodation in one of our new staff houses.

- Food in the new, modern staff restaurant.

- Work in an attractive environment with development opportunities.

If you appreciate an interesting, demanding and versatile activity in a dynamic environment and want to join a well-trained team, then we look forward to your complete online application.

Warnings before recruiting fraud

The Badrutt,s Palace Hotel will never require payment or financial information as part of the recruitment process. As a Chef de Partie, you will play a key role in ensuring the highest culinary standards and delivering an exceptional dining experience. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Preparing, cooking, and presenting high-quality dishes within your assigned kitchen section.

  • Ensuring consistent quality through the careful selection, preparation, and handling of fresh ingredients.

  • Supporting the development of seasonal menus and contributing creative ideas to enhance our culinary offering.

  • Maintaining the highest standards of food hygiene, safety, and cleanliness in accordance with HACCP regulations.

  • Working closely with the Executive Chef, Sous Chefs, and the wider kitchen team to ensure a smooth and efficient operation.

  • Assisting in the training and support of junior kitchen team members when required.

  • Managing your section efficiently while maintaining excellent quality, organization, and attention to detail.

• What you bring to the job

  • Completed professional training as a Chef or an equivalent qualification in the culinary field.

  • Previous experience as a Chef de Partie, ideally in a luxury hotel or fine dining environment.

  • Passion for high-quality cuisine with strong attention to detail and presentation.

  • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to work efficiently under pressure.

  • Sound knowledge of HACCP guidelines and food safety standards.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively as part of a team.

  • Good command of Italian and English.

Our offer

  • Fixed-term seasonal position from late November 2026 to early April 2027, with the opportunity to return for future seasons.

  • Average 5-day work week with 43.5 hours per week.

  • 5 weeks of annual vacation and 6 public holidays per year.

  • 13th-month salary from the start of employment (pro rata).

  • Accommodation available upon request in one of our modern staff residences.

  • Meals available in our new, modern staff restaurant.

  • An attractive working environment with excellent opportunities for professional growth and development.

Are you passionate about culinary excellence and looking for an exciting opportunity as a Chef de Partie in a luxury hotel environment? We look forward to receiving your complete online application and to welcoming you to our team.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

Badrutt's Palace Hotel will never request payment or financial information during the recruitment process. All official communication is sent exclusively from email addresses ending in @badruttspalace.com. If you receive any request for payment or suspicious communication, please disregard it and contact us directly through our official website.
descriptionByLocale.de:

- Zubereitung, Kochen und Präsentation von hochwertigen Gerichten in Ihrer zugewiesenen Küche.

- Gewährleistung der gleichbleibenden Qualität durch die sorgfältige Auswahl, Vorbereitung und Handhabung von frischen Zutaten.

- Unterstützung der Entwicklung von saisonalen Menüs und Beitrag kreative Ideen, um unser kulinarisches Angebot zu verbessern.

- Einhaltung der höchsten Standards für Lebensmittelhygiene, Sicherheit und Sauberkeit gemäß HACCP-Vorschriften.

- Zusammenarbeit mit dem Chefkoch Sous Chefs und dem breiteren Küchenteam, um einen reibungslosen und effizienten Betrieb zu gewährleisten.

- Unterstützung bei der Ausbildung und Unterstützung von Junior-Küchenteam-Mitgliedern, wenn erforderlich.

- Verwalten Sie Ihre Sektion effizient und gleichzeitig hervorragende Qualität, Organisation und Liebe zum Detail.

• Was Sie in den Job bringen

- Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Koch oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation im kulinarischen Bereich.

- Frühere Erfahrung als Chef de Partie, ideal in einem Luxushotel oder gehobene Gastronomie.

- Leidenschaft für hochwertige Küche mit viel Liebe zum Detail und Präsentation.

- Ausgezeichnete organisatorische Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, effizient unter Druck zu arbeiten.

- Guter Kenntnisstand der HACCP-Richtlinien und Lebensmittelsicherheitsstandards.

- Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit und die Fähigkeit, als Teil eines Teams effektiv zu arbeiten.

- Gute Beherrschung von Italienisch und Englisch.

Unser Angebot

- Saisonbefristung von Ende November 2026 bis Anfang April 2027, mit der Möglichkeit, für zukünftige Saisons zurückzukehren.

- Durchschnittliche 5-Tages-Arbeitswoche mit 43,5 Stunden pro Woche.

- 5 Wochen Jahresurlaub und 6 Feiertage pro Jahr.

- 13 Monate Gehalt ab Beginn der Beschäftigung (pro rata).

- Unterkunft auf Anfrage in einem unserer modernen Personal-Residenzen.

- Mahlzeiten in unserem neuen, modernen Personal Restaurant.

- Ein attraktives Arbeitsumfeld mit ausgezeichneten Möglichkeiten für professionelles Wachstum und Entwicklung.

- Préparation, cuisson et présentation de plats de haute qualité dans votre section de cuisine.

- Assurer une qualité cohérente grâce à la sélection, la préparation et la manipulation prudentes des ingrédients frais.

- Soutenir le développement de menus saisonniers et contribuer à la création d'idées pour améliorer notre offre culinaire.

- Aider à la formation et au soutien des membres de l'équipe de cuisine junior, au besoin.

- Gérer votre section efficacement tout en maintenant une excellente qualité, organisation et attention aux détails.

- Formation professionnelle complète en tant que Chef ou qualification équivalente dans le domaine culinaire.

- Expérience antérieure en tant que Chef de Partie, idéalement dans un hôtel de luxe ou un environnement gastronomique.

- Passion de cuisine de haute qualité avec une grande attention aux détails et à la présentation.

- Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et capacité de travailler efficacement sous pression.

- Connaissance approfondie des lignes directrices et des normes de salubrité des aliments HACCP.

- Des compétences en communication et la capacité de travailler efficacement dans le cadre d'une équipe.

- Bonne maîtrise de l'italien et de l'anglais.

Notre offre

- Position saisonnière à terme fixe de la fin novembre 2026 au début avril 2027, avec la possibilité de revenir pour les saisons futures.

- Moyenne de 5 jours de travail par semaine avec 43,5 heures par semaine.

- 5 semaines de vacances annuelles et 6 jours fériés par an.

- 13e mois de salaire à partir du début de l'emploi (pro rata).

- Hébergement disponible sur demande dans une de nos résidences modernes.

- Repas disponibles dans notre nouveau restaurant moderne.

- Un environnement de travail attrayant avec d'excellentes possibilités de développement professionnel.

Your key responsibilities

You will complement our Housekeeping team and be responsible for the following areas:

  • In close collaboration with the Executive Housekeeper, you will lead a team of approximately 70 Room Attendants and Floor Porters.

  • You will actively contribute to staff scheduling and help ensure the smooth and efficient running of daily operations.

  • • Your responsibilities will include inspecting arrival, stayover and departure rooms, as well as checking VIP setups, public areas and staff accommodation.

  • You will organise and order the materials required for daily operations and ensure that all deliveries meet our quality standards and are complete.

  • Through targeted training and continuous guidance, you will support the professional development of our employees and ensure compliance with our quality and hygiene standards.

  • You will act as a competent point of contact for our guests, responding to questions and individual requests while ensuring attentive and personalised service.

• What you bring to the job

For this varied and rewarding position, you ideally bring the following qualifications and experience:

  • You have completed professional training in the hotel industry and have gained relevant experience in a five-star hotel environment.

  • You have previous leadership experience and are confident in supporting the Executive Housekeeper with the management and coordination of a large team.

  • You have a very good command of written and spoken German, as well as good spoken English and Italian.

  • You are proficient in the use of standard Microsoft Office applications. Knowledge of Protel and Mirus would be an advantage.

  • You demonstrate a high level of initiative and commitment, combined with a strong focus on quality and guest satisfaction.

  • Your confident and well-groomed appearance, together with your excellent manners and interpersonal skills, complete your profile.

Our offer

  • Fixed-term seasonal position from mid-November 2026 until the beginning of April 2027

  • 5-day working week averaging 43.5 hours, with 5 weeks' holiday and 6 public holidays per year.

  • 13th month's salary from the start of employment (pro rata temporis).

  • Accommodation in one of our new staff houses.

  • Meals available in our new and modern staff restaurant.

  • Opportunity to work in an attractive environment with development and career growth opportunities.

If you appreciate an interesting, challenging and varied role in a dynamic environment and would like to join a well-established team, we look forward to receiving your complete online application.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

Badrutt’s Palace Hotel will never request payments or financial information as part of the recruitment process. All official communication is conducted exclusively through email addresses ending in @badruttspalace.com.

Should you receive a payment request or any suspicious communication, please disregard it and contact us directly through our official website.

Your key responsibilities

  • Support the Stewarding Manager in overseeing the stewarding operation across all hotel areas, ensuring high standards of cleanliness, hygiene, and organisation.

  • Act as deputy in the absence of the Stewarding Manager, ensuring continuity of operations and consistent leadership.

  • Lead and coordinate the stewarding team during assigned shifts, ensuring tasks are completed efficiently and to standard.

  • Assist in staff scheduling and daily workforce planning to ensure effective operational coverage.

  • Ensure the availability and proper handling of equipment and materials for kitchens, service areas, and events.

  • Collaborate closely with kitchen and service teams to maintain smooth and well-coordinated operations.

  • Monitor stock levels of detergents and consumables, supporting cost control and avoiding shortages.

  • Ensure compliance with HACCP and internal standards, while identifying opportunities to improve processes and organisation.

• What you bring to the job

  • Previous supervisory experience in stewarding, cleaning operations, or a similar role within hospitality.

  • Ability to lead a team during shifts, providing clear direction, support, and motivation.

  • Strong sense of responsibility, organisation, and attention to detail.

  • Ability to perform well under pressure while maintaining quality and efficiency.

  • Good communication skills in Portuguese and/or Italian and English.

  • Comfortable using basic computer systems (e.g. scheduling tools, stock control, internal systems).

  • Swiss or EU citizenship required due to work permit regulations.

Our offer

  • Fixed-term contract of 10 months, with the possibility of returning for future seasons

  • 5-day working week, averaging 43.5 hours

  • 5 weeks of holiday and 6 public holidays per year

  • 13th month salary from the start of employment (pro rata)

  • Accommodation in one of our modern staff houses

  • Meals available in our contemporary staff restaurant

  • A career in an attractive environment with opportunities for development

If you enjoy a varied and responsible role within a dynamic team and would like to contribute your experience and motivation, we look forward to receiving your complete online application.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

Badrutt's Palace Hotel will never request payment or financial information during the recruitment process. All official communication is sent exclusively from email addresses ending in @badruttspalace.com. If you receive any request for payment or suspicious communication, please disregard it and contact us directly through our official website.

Was Sie bei uns bewirken

  • Als Director of Brand & Marketing tragen Sie die Gesamtverantwortung für Marke und Marketing des Badrutt’s Palace über alle Touchpoints hinweg – Hotel, Restaurants, Bars, Spa, Retail und Events.

  • Sie entwickeln Positionierung, Markenbild, Tonalität und visuelle Identität konsequent weiter und sichern einen stimmigen, hochwertigen Markenauftritt.

  • Sie führen das Brand- und Marketingteam mit hohem Anspruch an Markenverständnis, kulturelle Sensibilität und Exzellenz.

  • Die gesamte digitale Präsenz der Marke steuern Sie über alle relevanten Kanäle hinweg. Dazu zählen Website Experience, Social Media, Content, Paid Media sowie SEO/GEO/SEM.

  • Sie entwickeln die eigenständige Social- und Content-Handschrift des Hauses weiter. Kulturelle Relevanz und ein klar definierter Luxus-Code stehen dabei im Fokus.

  • Sie verantworten das CRM als zentrales Beziehungs- und Wertschöpfungsinstrument im Luxussegment.

  • Relevante KPIs definieren, überwachen und steuern Sie als Grundlage für Transparenz und nachhaltige Wirkung.

  • Sie führen externe Partner und Agenturen mit klarem Qualitätsanspruch.


Das bringen Sie mit

Für diese sehr abwechslungsreiche Position bringen Sie idealerweise folgendes mit:

  • Ausgeprägtes Gespür für Ultra Luxury, Ästhetik, Sprache und Markenwirkung auf höchstem Niveau.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer leitenden Brand- und/oder Marketingfunktion im Premium- oder Luxusumfeld.

  • Nachweisliche Führungserfahrung auf Management- oder Geschäftsleitungsebene.

  • Umfassende digitale Kompetenz in Social Media, Content, Performance, Web und CRM.

  • Ausgeprägtes unternehmerisches Denken sowie hohe Entscheidungs- und Umsetzungskraft.

  • Souveräner Umgang mit internen und externen Senior Stakeholdern.

  • Sehr hohe Sprachkompetenz in Englisch, Deutsch von Vorteil..

  • Bereitschaft für ein anspruchsvolles, saisonales Umfeld.


Unser Angebot

  • Eine unbefristete Jahresstelle in einer der seltensten Brand-Rollen der internationalen Luxushotellerie.

  • Mitglied des Executive Committees (Excom) mit direktem Einfluss auf Marke und Gästeerlebnis.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your key responsibilities

As Sous Chef at Chesa Veglia, you are a key member of our culinary team, supporting our Head Chef in leading a first-class kitchen operation. Your main responsibilities include:

  • Proactively supporting the Head Chef in the planning and creation of menus, with a strong focus on freshness and quality.

  • Ensuring consistently high standards in both food presentation and taste.

  • Taking responsibility for compliance with hygiene standards in accordance with legal regulations.

  • Leading and supporting the kitchen team to ensure smooth day-to-day operations.

  • Managing the ordering and control of food supplies and kitchen equipment (purchasing system KOST).

  • Monitoring and ensuring adherence to hygiene and safety procedures (HACCP).


What you bring to the job

  • Completed vocational training as a chef (EFZ) or an equivalent, officially recognized qualification.

  • At least 3 years of professional experience in upscale gastronomy or hospitality, ideally with initial leadership experience.

  • Creativity and a genuine passion for preparing and presenting high-quality dishes

  • Strong organizational skills and an independent, structured, and resilient working style.

  • A team-oriented attitude, strong communication skills, and pronounced leadership qualities.

  • Very good Italian skills, good English skills; additional languages are an advantage.

  • Please note: You must be a Swiss or EU national to apply for this position.


Our offer

  • Fixed-term contract for 10 months

  • 5-day work week with an average of 43.5 hours per week.

  • 5 weeks of vacation and 6 public holidays per year.

  • 13th month salary from the start date (pro rata temporis).

  • Optional accommodation in modern staff residences, upon request.

  • Dining options in our new staff restaurant.

  • Excellent training and development opportunities.

If you are looking to take on a defining culinary leadership role within an exceptional hospitality environment, and wish to shape and influence the gastronomic direction of an internationally renowned house alongside a highly accomplished team, we look forward to receiving your complete online application.

Recruitment Fraud Warning

Badrutt's Palace Hotel will never request payment or financial information during the recruitment process. All official communication is sent exclusively from email addresses ending in @badruttspalace.com. If you receive any request for payment or suspicious communication, please disregard it and contact us directly through our official website.
